note: Two anchors. Frame::render_widget reports each call; Terminal::apply_buffer_with_cursor reports the frame boundary immediately after Backend::flush, which is the only point at which the frame's bytes are on the terminal and a render-commit marker may therefore be written. Both are behind #[cfg(feature = "std")]: ratatui-core is #![no_std] and gets std only because the ratatui facade enables it, so everything needing a socket lives in termwright-probe-ratatui instead. Measured: a --no-default-features build compiles and does not pull the probe crate in at all.

requires.reason: The dependency's path is machine-specific, so it cannot live in a patch file. The applier writes it into the copy's Cargo.toml, the way the Go probe's generated workspace supplies its module.
